prompt: Revise this customer message to acknowledge the problem without promising an uncertain result: 'Your parcel has not arrived. We have asked the delivery service to investigate. They have not yet given a date. We will send another update by Friday even if the investigation is unfinished.' A response of around 120 words is enough.
text: We’re sorry your parcel has not arrived as expected. We understand how frustrating and inconvenient this delay may be. We have contacted the delivery service and asked them to investigate, but they have not yet provided an expected delivery date or confirmed when the investigation will be completed. While we cannot promise a specific outcome or delivery time at this stage, we will continue to follow up with them. We will contact you again by Friday with any available information, even if the investigation is still ongoing. Thank you for your patience while we work to clarify what has happened.
